item.subject: science
item.stem:
Diya compares breathing and respiration. Breathing moves air into and out of the body as a physical process. Respiration is a chemical process inside the body that uses oxygen with a food substance such as sugar to help release energy. A new substance may form even if we cannot see it.

Which statement is correct?

options.A: Oxygen alone releases energy in respiration; no food substance is needed.
options.B: Breathing is a physical process of taking in and giving out air, while respiration is a chemical process that helps release energy inside the body.
options.C: Respiration produces oxygen, which breathing carries out of the body.
options.D: Respiration is a physical process because we cannot see a new substance forming.
